name: Mister Fantastic
oracle_text:
Reach, vigilance
At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you've cast a noncreature spell this turn, draw a card.
{R}{G}{W}{U}, {T}: Copy target triggered ability you control twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.
blocked_sentences: {R}{G}{W}{U}, {T}: Copy target triggered ability you control twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.

needs.what: a way for an `ability_on_stack` target spec to match only TRIGGERED abilities ("target triggered ability you control", Strionic Resonator, Mister Fantastic): a field on StackItem recording whether the ability on the stack is triggered or activated, and a selector clause (e.g. `ability_kind: "triggered"`) honoured by `_ability_matches` in both `candidates` and `still_legal`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `copy_ability` with `new_targets` covers the copy and the retargeting (twice is just two `copy_ability` effects on the same target), and the `ability_on_stack` target kind exists -- but `engine/targeting.py` `_ability_matches` honours only `controller` and its docstring explicitly refuses "triggered ability" alone: `StackItem.kind` is "ability" for both activated and triggered abilities and nothing records which, so the closest spec (Peter Parker's Camera's) would also let this copy an activated ability, a strictly wider card.
